lessonTitle: 29. Systems of a linear and a quadratic equation
lessonTitleEnglish: Systems of a linear and a quadratic equation
unit: Algebra · Chapter 5. Systems of rational equations
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 9 mathematics textbooks

stages.headline: If one equation is linear, express one unknown from it and substitute into the other to get a quadratic in one unknown.
stages.headlineEnglish: If one equation is linear, express one unknown from it and substitute into the other to get a quadratic in one unknown.

stages.headline: (y + 1)² + y² = 13 ⇒ y² + y − 6 = 0 ⇒ y = 2 or −3, giving x = 3 or −2.
stages.headlineEnglish: (y + 1)² + y² = 13 ⇒ y² + y − 6 = 0 ⇒ y = 2 or −3, giving x = 3 or −2.

stages.headline: In x + y = a, xy = b the numbers x and y are the roots of t² − at + b = 0 (Vieta).
